From Aedes' review

歳は初雪より2-3下に見えるが、学校に通うでもなく初雪の保護者を気取り、初雪の幸せと成長のみを純粋に願っている。

「もう、何やってるの。進学しても、お寝坊さんだなぁ！」
"Kawano Hatsuyuki. Who are you?... Are you living, or dead? Well... You may wander around a little more."

She is actually a Nature Spirit who resurrected Sakura in order to fulfill her role of destroying the Ghost Child. She doesn't really care about humanity, the town or the protagonist specifically, nor bears any grudge, so she fails to explain her motives after "killing" Ran thus becoming his enemy. She actually has only broken the link between the doll and remote puppeteer which had been brainwashing Hatsuyuki towards executing his vengeance. She wields the Silver Sword which hurts not body but soul, banishing ghosts. In the end, she starts to understand people better and think she really loved Sakura...

Hatsuyuki is a third-year student, one of the rare delinquents at his school. He reluctantly shows up in order to fulfill his graduation requirements. He is not your usual hetare nice guy protagonist. He has the reputation of being the guy you don’t mess with in school who can get his way just by staring at people, which has the unintended consequence of making everything he says sounds like threats. He didn’t exactly plan for this, but he couldn’t care less since he doesn’t care about socializing with other people. He is playful at times as well, often playing jokes on other people at their expenses.

He is actually the “Ghost Child”, the leader of all the ghosts in the city destined to destroy it at the end of winter and vanish along with it. Since he knows he wouldn’t exist for long, he doesn’t want to get attached to other people. Interestingly enough, he is neither fully human nor is he truly a ghost. He is the host to hundreds of ghosts who died in the hotel explosion infused with intense hatred against the city by his father, and if the ghosts inside him aren’t purged by the end of winter, he will become one of them and vanish.
From Aedes' review

He froze to death after being abandoned by his comrades in the streets. He appears as a ghost in Aya's route.

The principal of a school and the mayor of a city, as well as a politician. As an educator, he hopes that men can give up meaningless hatred, otherwise they will become "pathetic ghosts" and his Kasuga fighters will have to hunt them down.
Mochizuki "Shirokuma" Takara's maternal grandfather.
Hatsuyuki's father and Kasuga's former leader.

His family was killed by a terrorist attack indirectly launched by Sasaki. He tried to take revenge but failed and died in prison, so he possessed his son and appointed Ran to cultivate his son into a tool of revenge.

A mysterious girl dressed in a witch outfit.
In reality, she's the ghost of Yoru's younger self, that she summoned as an astral projection. Her purpose is to call upon the Ghost Child and have him exact revenge on the town in Yoru's place.
